question: Should Crabpot retain its current validated QQBot compatibility pin, or sponsor a fresh update that validates the newer upstream architecture and stream configuration?
rationale: The failed isolated fixture check and upstream architectural changes establish a concrete merge blocker, but selecting the supported upstream revision is a fixture-compatibility policy decision rather than a mechanical Dependabot repair.

options.title: Retain the current pin
options.body: Close or supersede this stale Dependabot update and keep the presently validated QQBot fixture revision.

options.title: Sponsor a validated upgrade
options.body: Create a fresh update from current `main` that refreshes the QQBot fixture evidence and passes the isolated changed-fixture validation.

recommendation.title: Retain the current pin
recommendation.body: Close or supersede this stale Dependabot update and keep the presently validated QQBot fixture revision.
